entries.label: Telogen Effluvium (Illness / Surgery / Medication)
entries.rationale: Per Excel Protocol Sequencer row 5: post-illness inflammation must be cleared and immune system rebuilt BEFORE TE kit can be effective.

entries.label: Male Pattern Hair Loss — MPHL (Grade 1-2-3)
entries.rationale: Phase 1 — TE GOLD: arrests active shedding. Phase 2 — PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION: clears chronic scalp inflammatory load (NF-kB/TNF-alpha); must precede MPHL. Phase 3 — MPHL: 5-alpha reductase inhibition effective in cleared terrain. Phase 4 — PRO FACT META B: corrects insulin-androgen axis. Phase 5 — PRO IMMUNE GOLD: nutritional regrowth supply; always last.

entries.label: Male Pattern Hair Loss — MPHL (Grade 4-5 Advanced)
entries.rationale: Advanced grade needs stronger immune support first; PRO IMMUNE GOLD primes follicle rescue environment; MPHL DHT blockade second; PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION clears microenvironment in Phase 3.

entries.label: Female Pattern Hair Loss — FPHL (Grade 1-2-3)
entries.rationale: Phase 1 — TE GOLD: arrests active shedding. Phase 2 — PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION: clears chronic scalp inflammatory load; must precede FPHL. Phase 3 — FPHL: corrects androgenetic miniaturisation. Phase 4 — PRO FACT META B: corrects metabolic terrain. Phase 5 — PRO IMMUNE GOLD: nutritional regrowth supply; always last.
entries.ageOverride: Female < 30 with genetics: phases overridden to ['HAIR FACT TE GOLD', 'PRO IMMUNE GOLD'] — follicle not miniaturised enough for FPHL

entries.label: Female Pattern Hair Loss — FPHL (Grade 4-5 Advanced)
entries.rationale: Advanced female AGA — PRO IMMUNE GOLD primes environment; FPHL corrects androgenetic pattern; PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION clears scalp microenvironment.

entries.label: PCOS — Hormonal Hair Loss
entries.rationale: PCOS hormonal correction drives Phase 1; inflammation cleared in Phase 2; TE GOLD addresses concurrent shedding in Phase 3.
entries.precisionStackNote: Additional kits (FPHL, PRO IMMUNE, IRON UP GOLD) injected ONLY when patient's actual signals confirm those conditions. A pure PCOS case = 1 kit only.

entries.label: PCOS + Metabolic (Insulin Resistance)
entries.rationale: PRO FACT META B PCOS is the single primary kit — combines AMPK/insulin correction (Berberine) with androgen suppression (Inositol+D-Chiro+Spearmint). F-PCOS -1 NOT prescribed (duplicates ingredients).
entries.precisionStackNote: Additional kits added ONLY for confirmed co-condition signals. FORBIDDEN: F-PCOS -1 and PRO FACT META B PCOS in same protocol.

entries.label: Thyroid (Hypothyroid)
entries.rationale: Thyroid metabolic correction unlocks cellular metabolism first; PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION clears the inflammation that hypothyroidism drives; TE GOLD stops concurrent diffuse shedding in Phase 3.
entries.overrideRule: If obesity/sedentary lifestyle also present: PRO FACT META B HYPOTHYROID swapped for PRO FACT META B (v34 override)

entries.label: Thyroid (Hyperthyroid)
entries.rationale: PRO FACT THYROID CARE corrects hyperthyroid metabolic overactivity first; TE GOLD addresses concurrent diffuse shedding; PRO IMMUNE GOLD rebuilds immunity depleted by hyperthyroid-driven oxidative stress.

entries.label: Alopecia Areata (Autoimmune)
entries.rationale: AA-specific kit (autoimmune hair loss first); META B supports metabolic terrain; inflammation cleared; PRO IMMUNE rebuilds immune balance

entries.label: Peri-Menopause
entries.rationale: PERI MENOPAUSE kit stabilises hormonal fluctuation first; FPHL corrects androgenetic pattern driven by oestrogen decline; TE GOLD stops active shedding; PRO IMMUNE GOLD consolidates.
entries.metabolicModifier: If metabolic signal (obesity/sedentary/weight): PRO FACT META B inserted at position 1 (after PERI kit, before TE GOLD)

entries.label: Post-Menopause
entries.rationale: Post-menopausal metabolic shift corrected first; FPHL corrects androgenetic pattern; TE GOLD addresses concurrent shedding; PRO IMMUNE GOLD consolidates immune support.

entries.label: Endometriosis
entries.rationale: FH WELL 3 targets endometriotic hormonal-inflammatory balance first; PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION clears systemic inflammation; PRO IMMUNE GOLD modulates immune response.

entries.label: Pregnancy
entries.rationale: HEALTHY-9 is PREGNANCY ONLY — single kit, no other kits during pregnancy

entries.label: Iron Deficiency / Anaemia
entries.rationale: IRON UP GOLD restores ferritin first (non-negotiable); TE GOLD stops shedding once iron is corrected; PRO IMMUNE explicitly listed for iron deficiency cases

entries.label: Scalp Inflammation (Dandruff / Oily / Seborrhoea)
phases: AGA_GENDER (resolves to MPHL or FPHL at runtime)
entries.rationale: Inflammation must be cleared before AGA correction

entries.label: Hair Breakage (Chemical / Heat / Hard water)
entries.rationale: HBR repairs shaft damage first; PHENOTYPE INFLAMMATION clears scalp inflammation. TE GOLD added only if active shedding signals present

entries.label: Night Shift / Circadian Disruption
entries.rationale: Circadian reset is the primary driver (NIGHT SHIFT first); TE GOLD repairs concurrent shedding; PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION clears the oxidative/inflammatory load from chronic sleep disruption.

entries.label: Frequent Flying / Circadian + Immune Stress
entries.rationale: Circadian and travel stress corrected first; TE GOLD repairs concurrent shedding; PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION clears cabin radiation and passive smoke oxidative load.

entries.label: Smoking / Alcohol / Vaping / Oxidative Stress
entries.rationale: Inflammation and oxidative damage require sequential correction; PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION enables the OXIDATIVE STRESS kit; PRO IMMUNE GOLD rebuilds immune defence.

entries.label: Sudden Weight Loss (Crash diet / GLP-1 / Illness)
entries.rationale: Rapid weight loss is the PRECIPITATING EVENT. Phase 1: RAPID WEIGHT LOSS SHIELD arrests shedding at the GLP-1/nutrient-deficit trigger. Phase 2: HAIR FACT TE GOLD in REDUCED SCOPE only — iron/ferritin repletion + residual stress-TE. Full-scope TE GOLD FORBIDDEN (ingredient overlap with Shield: Iron, B12, Zinc, Biotin, Selenium, Amino Complex). Phase 3: PRO IMMUNE GOLD rebuilds immunity.

entries.label: Trichotillomania (Hair Pulling / OCD)

entries.label: Chronic Medical Condition (BP / other)

entries.label: Diabetes / Pre-Diabetes (Metabolic Hair Loss)
entries.rationale: Insulin resistance drives androgen amplification and chronic inflammation. PRO FACT META B corrects insulin-AMPK pathway first; PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION clears chronic hyperglycaemia-driven inflammatory load; PRO IMMUNE GOLD rebuilds immune resilience.

entries.label: Gut Issues (GERD / IBS / Bloating / Crohn's)
entries.rationale: Gut-hair axis must be cleared first (GI GOLD); PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION addresses gut-driven systemic inflammation; PRO IMMUNE GOLD rebuilds gut-depleted immunity; TE GOLD addresses TE shedding last once gut absorption is restored.

entries.label: Mouth / Tongue Ulcers (Immune-Gut link)
entries.rationale: Gut-immune inflammation cleared first; PRO IMMUNE GOLD rebuilds immune defence; OXIDATIVE STRESS kit addresses the free radical load driving ulceration.

entries.label: Multi-factorial (Stress + Gut + Pattern combined)
entries.rationale: Inflammation is the universal terrain for multi-factorial — always Phase 1; TE GOLD stops active shedding; GI GOLD restores absorption; AGA_GENDER corrects pattern loss last

entries.label: Early / Premature Greying
entries.rationale: Root cause corrected first along with specific nutritional deficiencies; OXIDATIVE STRESS addresses free radical damage driving premature pigment loss; PRO IMMUNE GOLD builds immunity to protect melanocytes.

entries.label: Hair Regrowth — Active Shedding Stopped

PRO IMMUNE GOLD stimulates follicle re-entry into anagen phase via EGF/Colostrum/Lactoferrin; PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION clears residual scalp inflammation; PRO FACT META B corrects metabolic terrain sustaining dormancy.

hiddenRules.name: THYROID_IN_HORMONAL_CROSS_DEPENDENCY

hiddenRules.name: PCOS_PRIORITY_BOOST_FROM_THYROID
hiddenRules.description: If PCOS + Hypothyroidism both selected, PCOS score is boosted to 101 — making it beat THYROID_HYPO at 100. This hidden coupling means thyroid co-morbidity with PCOS unexpectedly elevates PCOS to dominant (not thyroid).

hiddenRules.name: HORMONAL_THYROID_OPTION_RUNTIME_REMOVED
hiddenRules.description: 'Thyroid disorder' option is programmatically removed from hormonal question at runtime via IIFE. The HTML originally includes it; an IIFE deletes it before any user sees it. Downstream code that checks hormonal includes 'Thyroid' still works because of the cross-dependency with thyroid field.

hiddenRules.name: TE_GOLD_REGROW_SUPPRESSION_ABSOLUTE
hiddenRules.description: TE GOLD is suppressed for ALL protocols when isRegrowGoal=true — even protocols like THYROID_HYPO and PERI_MENOPAUSE that normally include TE GOLD. However, if hormonal conditions are detected under regrow path (post-menopause, PCOS, thyroid), those hormonal protocols take precedence over REGROW_ONLY.

hiddenRules.name: PCOS_PRECISION_STACK_CAP_7
hiddenRules.description: PCOS protocols use a dedicated cap of 7 kits (vs standard 4-5 for other protocols). This allows PCOS+Obesity+FPHL+Inflammation+Immune+HBR to coexist when clinical signals support it.

hiddenRules.name: OXIDATIVE_STRESS_2_SIGNAL_THRESHOLD
hiddenRules.description: OXIDATIVE STRESS kit is only injected as a standalone phase when oxidativeCount >= 2 (requires at least 2 of: Smoking/Vaping, Alcohol, Asthma) AND PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION is not already in the protocol. Single smoking selection → PHENOTYPE only. Two signals → OXIDATIVE STRESS added as separate phase.

hiddenRules.name: HEAT_CHEMICAL_TREATMENT_INSUFFICIENT_FOR_HBR
hiddenRules.description: Heat styling or chemical treatment alone does NOT trigger HBR kit. Patient must ALSO report Hard water in cause as the corroborating shaft-damage signal. (Q3 'Broken/short' hairtype option retired — no longer a valid corroborating signal.)

hiddenRules.name: ACTIVE_SHEDDING_TE_GOLD_PROMOTION_OVERRIDES_PROTOCOL
hiddenRules.description: hasActiveShedding=true causes TE GOLD to be unshifted to position 0, overriding the clinically-sequenced PROTOCOL_SEQUENCER phase order. This happens AFTER the sequencer lookup, meaning TE GOLD can jump ahead of protocol-specified Phase 1 kits (like PRO IMMUNE GOLD in THYROID_HYPER).

hiddenRules.name: PCOS_ONLY_SIGNAL_GATE
hiddenRules.description: At runtime, a PCOS_ONLY patient with no metabolic signals present gets F-PCOS -1 re-inserted as Phase 1 (after TE GOLD if active shedding), even if the injection pool logic was not triggered. This is a late-stage injection at lines 3944-3959.

hiddenRules.name: IRON_UP_GOLD_POSITION_LOGIC
hiddenRules.description: IRON UP GOLD is inserted after the PCOS/TE kit but before other injection pool kits, via a specific position-finding algorithm. It checks for F-PCOS positions first, then META B PCOS, then TE GOLD — inserting IRON UP GOLD directly after whichever is found.

hiddenRules.name: DURATION_HAIRTYPE_QUESTION_TRIPLE_SKIP
hiddenRules.description: Three questions (duration, count, hairtype) all share the same _skipIf logic: skip if goal includes 'regrow', 'greying', 'Greying', or 'Early greying'. These are separate _skipIf functions per step — not a single shared rule. The chat loop evaluates each individually.

hiddenRules.name: PCOS_STACK_HANDLED_FLAG
hiddenRules.description: S._pcosStackHandled=true prevents duplicate PRO IMMUNE injection from the generic injection pool (Step 5b) when PCOS precision stack has already handled immune kit injection. Without this flag, PCOS patients would receive double PRO IMMUNE injection.

hiddenRules.name: REGROW_GOAL_PCOS_SCORES_POPULATED_FOR_UI
hiddenRules.description: Under regrow goal + PCOS path, S._conditionScores is manually populated before the early return so the 'Conditions Detected' UI section renders correctly (would otherwise be empty).

ambiguousLogicFound.description: 'Erratic / Outside eating (3-4x/week)' in lifestyle is tagged to hasMetabolicSignal via diet field matching 'Irregular'/'poor', but this is a lifestyle option, not a diet option. The has() check in diet array would not catch this. The lifestyle option label contains 'Erratic' and 'eating' — cross-array dependency is implicit.
ambiguousLogicFound.location: getFunnelKits hasMetabolicSignal calculation line 3517 vs STEPS[10] lifestyle option 'Erratic'

ambiguousLogicFound.description: GLP-1 'after 6 months' adds both WEIGHT_LOSS score +90 AND TE_STRESS score +50 simultaneously. This means two conditions are scored, but WEIGHT_LOSS at 90 still dominates TE_STRESS at 50. The practical effect is TE GOLD being promoted to Kit 1 via hasActiveShedding logic — but this promotion happens INDEPENDENTLY of the score, making the +50 TE_STRESS score effectively unused.
ambiguousLogicFound.location: matchProtocol lines 4331-4336; getFunnelKits active shedding logic lines 3925-3942

ambiguousLogicFound.description: 'None of the above' option handling: several multi-select questions include a 'None of the above' option. No explicit deselection logic exists — if a user selects 'None' AND another option, both would be sent to the scoring engine. No mutual exclusion enforced for 'None'.

hasActiveShedding signal combines 'OR duration includes 1-3/3-6' — but duration question is skipped for regrow/greying goals. If goal='Reduce hair fall' was selected AND duration was answered as '1-3 months', the signal fires correctly. However, if duration was skipped (regrow goal) but the same hasActiveShedding check runs (which it does for non-regrow goals), the stale ans.duration value from a prior session could affect scoring.

clinicalArchitectureObservations: The system uses a dual-layer engine: (1) matchProtocol() as a weighted scoring engine producing a dominant protocol key; (2) getFunnelKits() as a modifier injection engine that applies co-condition kit injections on top. These are cleanly separated.

PROTOCOL_SEQUENCER acts as a lookup table of clinically-ordered phase arrays — this is the only place where kit sequence is authoritative. All other logic only adds/removes/repositions relative to this baseline.
VEG kit variants are resolved at a single resolveKit() function — centralized and easy to maintain.

The 'PRO IMMUNE always last' rule (Step 9) is an architectural pattern that ensures the growth supply kit is always delivered into a prepared terrain. This is a deliberate biological sequencing principle baked into code.
Kit cap calculation is dynamic (4-7 kits) based on patient complexity — this prevents over-prescription for simple cases while allowing comprehensive protocols for multi-factorial presentations.

The PCOS precision stack (S._pcosStackHandled flag) is the most complex sub-engine, with 7+ decision points and a dedicated cap. It represents a clinically-grounded attempt to prevent over-prescription ('a doctor does not prescribe 4-5 kits for a pure PCOS case').
dangerousHiddenCouplings: COUPLING_001: THYROID_HYPO triggered by BOTH thyroid field AND hormonal field — if hormonal 'Thyroid' option was not removed by IIFE (e.g. bug in IIFE), patients could get double THYROID_HYPO scoring.

COUPLING_002: PCOS priority boost (92→101) when Hypothyroid co-selected causes PCOS to outrank its own co-morbidity (thyroid). If a patient has severe hypothyroid as the true primary driver plus mild PCOS, the system still routes to PCOS protocol — potentially under-treating the thyroid.

COUPLING_003: hasActiveShedding unshifts TE GOLD to position 0 AFTER protocol sequencer sets the order, creating silent override of the PROTOCOL_SEQUENCER's clinically-intended Phase 1 kit. For protocols where PRO IMMUNE is intended to be Phase 1 (AGA_MALE_45, THYROID_HYPER), active shedding will displace it.

COUPLING_004: GLP-1 early re-enforcement runs TWICE — once in the main GLP-1 early block (lines 3895-3901) and once in a re-enforcement block (lines 3991-3998) after liftPhase reordering. If liftPhase is modified to include RAPID WEIGHT LOSS SHIELD, this double-enforcement could create unexpected ordering.

COUPLING_005: S._pcosStackHandled flag prevents generic PRO IMMUNE injection for PCOS patients. But this flag is set on S (global state object). If getFunnelKits() is called multiple times without resetting S, the flag persists and incorrectly blocks PRO IMMUNE for non-PCOS subsequent calls.
suggestedNormalizationOpportunities: NORM_001: The hasActiveShedding calculation is duplicated in both buildPrompt() (for LLM instruction) and getFunnelKits() (for kit ordering). Extract to a shared function.
NORM_002: The _skipIf function for duration/count/hairtype is identical across all three STEPS — could be a single shared predicate function reference.
NORM_003: The has(arr, v) helper is defined independently in matchProtocol(), getFunnelKits(), and localClinicalEngine() — three copies of the same case-insensitive substring matcher.
NORM_004: Protocol-key-to-label mapping exists in PROTOCOL_SEQUENCER[key].label AND is also reconstructed in localClinicalEngine() as a separate variable. Single source of truth would reduce drift.
NORM_005: VEG variant lookup in resolveKit() uses string comparison chains (if/else if). Could be expressed as a lookup table for cleaner extension when new VEG variants are added.

NORM_006: The scoring engine in matchProtocol() and the injection pool in getFunnelKits() have overlapping logic for detecting scalp inflammation, immune signals, and metabolic signals. Shared signal detection functions would reduce inconsistency risk.
